title: All Tube Stations Have Fifteen Floors
summary: Geoff Marshall explains a running gag about London Underground stair signs claiming that the climb equals 15 floors, regardless of how many steps there actually are.
why: Cited as the explanation for the oddly inaccurate tube staircase signs, and as an example of Marshall's station-detail videos.

quote.text: Geoff has a bunch of videos about the details of stations or ticket systems.
